decisions.reason: Moving the battery connector to the back does not change the candidate's existing USB-C position, mounting-hole, board-size, aspect-ratio, JST-form, base-integration, or enclosure-fit constraints.
The source changes only the battery connector's placement and does not alter component sourcing, availability, compatibility, or cost requirements.
Battery connector placement has no entailed effect on I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
